lines.en: Squeak, squeak, squeak!
Phantom flutters, night grows longer.
Under moonlight, I grow fiercer.
Creaking, ghost wheel turns.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里爬起来，鼓还在响。
lines.en: I rise from the dark, my drum still sounding.
Nightfall, my time comes.
Phantom sway, blood souls fly.
Creak creak, evil ghost moves.
Under moon, I fear not.
Blood dance, ghost song!

lines.zh: 辘轳绞着井绳，我一圈圈走。
lines.en: The pulley winds the well rope; I pace in circles.

lines.zh: 骨头嘎吱作响，我挪过林子。
lines.en: My bones creak as I shuffle through the woods.
Silently wait, foe comes!
In darkness, I endure.
Ghost flames make me shrewder.
Moonlight hides me.
Night breeze, I alone.
Phantom shadows, I wait.
Moonbeams, I vanish.
Darkness, I am silent.
Waiting for foes!
Moonlit, I await.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的工夫，我就到你面前。
lines.en: In the blink of your eye, I am before you.
Ghost eyes watch, ghost steps near.
Your scent, I sense it.
Ghost flames reveal you.
Phantom flashes, I approach.
Ghost eyes gleam, you can’t escape.
You move, I come, creak!
Ghost flames, you hide nowhere.
Phantom shows, you nowhere flee.
Ghost eyes watch, I come!
Bloodied, yet I won't die!
Flames of the ghoul, still burning!
Swords may fail, but not my spirit!
Debt of blood, death is not enough!

lines.zh: 魂归幽冥，你仍敌不过我！
lines.en: Souls to hell, yet you can't defeat me!

lines.zh: 不死之身，死神也奈何不了我！
lines.en: My immortal body, even death cannot touch me!
Shadow of the blade, yet I won't die!

lines.zh: 幽冥之手，仍紧紧攥住你！
lines.en: Grip of the underworld, still holding you!
Dance of the ghoul, life and death at my will!
Immortal body, you can't hurt me!

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，真让辘轳我食欲大增！
lines.en: Your scent really makes Rokuro hungry!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的少年，来陪辘轳我吃个晚餐吧！
lines.en: Come eat with Rokuro, young Men of the Demon Slayers!

lines.zh: 你的血液，足够辘轳我享用一晚！
lines.en: Your blood is enough for Rokuro to feast on!

lines.zh: 喂，少年，你闻起来很美味哦！
lines.en: Hey, you smell delicious!

lines.zh: 快来，快进来陪辘轳我玩玩！
lines.en: Come in, come play with Rokuro!

lines.zh: 这股气味，真是让辘轳我流口水！
lines.en: That smell makes Rokuro drool!

lines.zh: 你想品尝一下辘轳的滋味吗？
lines.en: Do you want to taste Rokuro?

lines.zh: 少年，陪辘轳我玩玩怎么样？
lines.en: How about playing with Rokuro, boy?

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，让辘轳我都心动了！
lines.en: Your scent has Rokuro in a frenzy!

lines.zh: 你闻起来就像是我的晚餐！
lines.en: You smell like Rokuro's dinner!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的家伙，撞上辘轳我了！
lines.en: Men of the Demon Slayers, you've collided with Rokuro!

lines.zh: 嘿，你撞到辘轳我了，别跑！
lines.en: Hey, you bumped into Rokuro, don't run!

lines.zh: 你躲不过辘轳我的追击！
lines.en: You can't escape Rokuro!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的家伙，你来撞我？
lines.en: Men of the Demon Slayers, you want to crash into Rokuro?

lines.zh: 撞上辘轳我吧，享受下滋味！
lines.en: Collide with Rokuro, feel the taste!

lines.zh: 嘿，你撞到辘轳我身上了！
lines.en: Hey, you bumped into Rokuro!

lines.zh: 小心，鬼杀队的家伙撞上辘轳我了！
lines.en: Watch out, Men of the Demon Slayers, you've collided with Rokuro!

lines.zh: 你撞到了辘轳我，尝尝吧！
lines.en: You've crashed into Rokuro, taste it!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的家伙，你来个亲密接触吧！
lines.en: Men of the Demon Slayers, come for a close collision with Rokuro!

lines.zh: 你撞上了辘轳我，享受一下吧！
lines.en: You've collided with Rokuro, enjoy it!

lines.zh: 快来，和辘轳我生个鬼吧！
lines.en: Come, mate with Rokuro to create a demon!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的少年，和辘轳我交个朋友吧！
lines.en: Men of the Demon Slayers, be Rokuro's mate!

lines.zh: 你愿意和辘轳我同生共死吗？
lines.en: Will you mate with Rokuro?

lines.zh: 来，和辘轳我一起战斗吧！
lines.en: Come, fight with Rokuro!
Do you want to be with Rokuro?
Mate with Rokuro to the end!
Mate with Rokuro!

lines.zh: 和辘轳我共享这夜晚吧！
lines.en: Mate with Rokuro under the night!

lines.zh: 你想和辘轳我同生共死吗？
lines.en: Do you want to be Rokuro's mate?

lines.zh: 和辘轳我一起，享受这夜晚！
lines.en: Mate with Rokuro, enjoy the night!

lines.zh: 我闻到了鬼杀队的气味。
lines.en: I smell the scent of Demon Slayers.

lines.zh: 这里一定有鬼杀队成员。
lines.en: There must be Demon Slayers here.
Come closer, and I will kill you.

lines.zh: 我的血鬼术会吞噬你的灵魂。
lines.en: My blood technique will consume your soul.
You smell like a Demon Slayer.
I will tear you apart.

lines.zh: 箭头指向你手里的东西。
lines.en: My arrow points at what's in your hand.

lines.zh: 我会用我的利爪撕裂你。
lines.en: I will rip you apart with my claws.
Darkness is my home.
I will devour your life.

lines.zh: 下弦之贰辘轳，血鬼术转起来了。
lines.en: Lower Moon Two Rokuro — my Blood Demon Art spins up.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的血，我尝过一次就忘不了。
lines.en: Once I tasted a Demon Slayer's blood, I never forgot it.
I have my target.
You are close to death.
I will enjoy killing you.

lines.zh: 月光下你的影子，跑不掉了。
lines.en: Your shadow in the moonlight cannot escape.
My blood technique will rule you.
I will rip your heart open.
My strength will surpass yours.
I will enjoy your pain.
Lower Rank Two has its eyes on you.

lines.zh: 你的队服，我认得那花纹。
lines.en: I know that pattern on your uniform.

lines.zh: 太阳还远，我有的是时间。
lines.en: Sunrise is far off; I have all the time I need.

lines.zh: 十六尺的距离，我一步就够。
lines.en: Sixteen feet of distance — one step is enough.

lines.zh: 血鬼术一动，树影全歪了。
lines.en: My art stirs, and every tree shadow bends.
I will taste your blood.
I will drain your blood.
My claws will tear you open.
You cannot escape my claws.
I will pull your heart out.
I will make you die in pain.
I will tear you apart

lines.zh: 血鬼术已经顺着影子爬过去了。
lines.en: My blood demon art has crawled along the shadows.
I will crush your heart.
I will enjoy your agony.
I fling the well rope out to coil around you.
You step back; I wind one more turn.
Don't cut the rope; it tightens the more you cut.

lines.zh: 你的刀，卡在树杈上了吧。
lines.en: Your blade is stuck in the branches, isn't it?
I perch on your back and watch you tremble.
Chasing people at night never tires me.
Your breathing has gone ragged. Good.
I lead you deeper into the woods.

lines.zh: 抬头，我在你上面的枝头。
lines.en: Look up; I'm on the branch above you.
This night, you belong to Rokuro.
Steel jaws bite, blood rain follows.
Ghostly form haunts, chilling aura.
Under moonlight, sharp claws slash.
In black mist, fangs gleam coldly.
Ghostly wails, sharp claw strike.
Bite under moonlight, bloody mess.
Chilly wind, iron teeth clash.
Night reveals sharp fangs.
Evil ghost bites, blood splatters.
Moonlight reveals tearing fangs.
The rope bites into your wrist!
I sink my teeth into your shoulder!
Claws rip open your uniform!
I throw my whole weight on your back!
A creak, and you stagger half a step.
My art bursts into a cloud of black mist!
I slam you against a tree trunk!
Once I bite, I don't let go. Remember that.
Night falls, evil ghost awakens.
Dark night, evil ghost prowls.
Under moonlight, evil ghost appears.
Dark moonless night, ghostly forms.
Moon sets, ghost appears.
Dark curtain falls, evil ghost sneaks.
Faint moonlight, evil ghost manifests.
Dark clouds, evil ghost appears.
Night falls, evil ghost awakens.
Dark night, evil ghost lurks.

lines.zh: 树干上多了一张脸，是我。
lines.en: Another face appears on the trunk: mine.
Night mist hugs the ground and I take shape.

lines.zh: 吱呀一声，我从树后转出。
lines.en: With a creak, I swing out from behind the tree.
The moon clears the branches; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 火烧上我的绳子，我松开手。
lines.en: Fire climbs my rope; I let go.
Falling... falling... into hell!
Drowned, yet I won't die!

lines.zh: 轰鸣，轰出我的不死之身！
lines.en: Boom! My immortality survives!
Arrows pierce, yet I won't die!
Magic strikes, yet I won't die!
Starvation, yet I won't die!
Lightning strikes, yet I won't die!
Void devours, yet I won't die!
